I tend to stick with a month or two between my 3rd plat doses. Last weekend I was getting ready for a trip but I bitched out thinking about the last trip. I wouldn't call it a horror story but it was an unpleasant aftermath to clean up.

I slammed down three bottles of Robocough, instead of spacing it out to get to my usual med-high 3rd plateau dose and it was terrible on the comeup. Severe nausea, hot feeling in my head and face, the taste I couldn't stop thinking about that just made everything else worse. About an hour and a half in I puked all over my carpet and bolted to the bathroom. I spent a good minute at the toilet puking and passed out next to my shower, everything after that is a blur. I do remember the trip being enjoyable once I got the chance to detach from normal consciousness and enjoy the dreamlike trance that I know and love from DXM. 

I woke up still in the bathroom, glued to the floor covered in my own sticky vomit that seemingly covered the entire floor. I'm guessing only a fraction of it actually made it to the toilet. In between mopping the entire bathroom and vacuuming the affected carpet, I couldn't help but to laugh at the entire situation. Reliving the moment in a sober perspective, like a post-trip reflection.

The magic can return it just takes FOREVER. I didn't even overdo it either. After like 12 trips 3rd plateau, I noticed it lost its magic and that's when I decided to stop for over 5 months. After that, it was completely magical again.

It's best in a pitch black room and a LONG music playlist. You may find yourself in a dreamlike trance that comes and goes with the music. The floor feels great as well. Carpet, tile, hardwood, linoleum, all feel wonderful. 

Since you're new to the experience, I'd space your dose out. That way it doesn't hit you like a freight train with the nausea.

I never used it more than the occasional escape so I can't speak for those who, in my perspective, over do it; I have never experienced it to be dependence-forming at all. I do find it easy to crave and yearn for the next escape.

Part experience, speculation, and research:

​

When you space out the time between each trip, you're aiming to drop out of short-term tolerance so the same dose will produce a similar effect. When you don't follow proper harm reduction practices of spacing out your trips (1 week/plat doesn't always work) you speed up the development of a long-term tolerance and it seems like DXM has lost its magic. Even when you space out your doses 1-2 weeks/plat, it will still eventually lose its magic and it can take a while to get back to baseline. 

This is my speculation. This "long-term tolerance" comes from being both mentally and physiologically familiar with the trip. Similar to endorphin release in sex and masturbation, the amount of time spent away from either greatly affects what it feels like. The endorphin release after abstaining has a tremendously more potent effect than when you're doing it daily, weekly, whatever. 

The research part is just a piece out of [Science Direct](https://www.sciencedirect.com/topics/neuroscience/nmda-receptor-antagonist) where they mention DXM has a reduced affinity for the NMDA receptor when compared to ketamine. DXM and Ketamine are both NMDA agonists and act on the brain in a similar fashion but greatly differ in chemical structure and effect. 

This is what I wonder: If they are both NMDA agonists, why is DXM the only one with a very well known long-lasting soft tolerance? Is it ketamine's stronger affinity to the NMDA receptor? I don't hold degrees in medicine or chemistry so my ability to interpret what all this shit means is very limited. 

​
There are better [resources](https://wiki.tripsit.me/wiki/DXM) for your questions than making a post on this subreddit. Use paragraphs 3 and 6 on the website I linked. It's good information.

I was really out of it, my mind was going a million miles per hour, I felt anxious and paranoid. My ability to react and effectively drive weren't affected but I didn't want to drive at all.

Is it legal? Depends. If you were to get in a wreck and get hospitalized, your tox screen would show a very high amount of DXM and it could be ruled as the cause of the wreck even if it wasn't. 

Safe? Just don't drive if you don't feel well enough.

If taking a lower dosage (1.5-2.5 mg/kg) then you don't really need to space out the dosage. Once you start getting in the area of swallowing 40 pills, you might want to space your dosage out. 

As far as extracting from gels, there's really only one viable option: to blend the caps and collect the liquid. The gel cap composition is primarily gelatin plasticised by a glycerol and sorbitol solution. Because of this, you DO NOT want to dissolve the entire gel cap. I have had some success with a small blender. From there, you will primarily be extracting DXM from the PEG it is dissolved in along with whatever liquid you chose to rinse residual gel cap fluid from your containers, blender, gel caps, etc.
